about: THE RELAY'S PATHS (kit 0.14.3, deep review KIT-14) — RelayPaths.cs and the website's relay-protocol.ts both said 'byte-for-byte, change both or neither' and nothing held them to it. Each case is a project whose relay root is decided by which status.json exists (none → Library/AdRelay; only the legacy AdRelay/status.json → AdRelay), and each path relative to the project, '/'-separated. Held by the kit's RelayPathsTests and the renderer's relay-protocol.spec.ts.

cases.name: a fresh project: the preferred root under Library/
a pre-0.3 project whose relay still lives in the project-root AdRelay/
both exist: the preferred root wins
